response.sql:
WITH per_driver AS (
  SELECT
    r.driverId,
    SUM(r.points) AS points_total,
    AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps
  FROM results AS r
  WHERE r.grid >= 12
  GROUP BY r.driverId
)
SELECT AVG(points_total) AS average_points_total,
       AVG(average_laps) AS average_of_average_laps
FROM per_driver;

assumptions.assumption: A missing laps value is stored as NULL, so AVG ignores it; drivers with qualifying results are included even if every laps value for them is missing (their average laps is NULL and is ignored in the final average).
